headline: Abhinandan Varthaman Retires From IAF and Joins Goa Airline
summary: Group Captain Abhinandan Varthaman has retired from the Indian Air Force and joined Goa-based carrier FLY91 as a commercial pilot. He is widely recognized for downing a Pakistani F-16 fighter jet in 2019.

headline: Goa Announces Three Free LPG Cylinders Annually
summary: The Goa government will provide citizens with three free LPG cylinders annually, ensuring beneficiaries receive Rs 3,000 under the scheme. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant stated that the reimbursement will be credited by September 10.

headline: Ancient Relics Unearthed During Temple Restoration
summary: Important archaeological items and stone relics dating back to the 14th-16th centuries have been discovered during restoration work at the Saptakoteshwar Temple and near the Koti Tirtha tank at Divar. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant highlighted the historical significance of the findings.

headline: Police Personnel Suspended Over Extortion Probe
summary: Goa police cracked down on errant personnel following an extortion probe involving a controversial audio clip about a 'Rs 30 lakh payment'. Four officers have been suspended and a PSI transferred.

headline: Goa to Shift Stray Dogs to Shelters Amid Rising Bite Cases
summary: Amid reports of 53 dog-bite cases every day until mid-August, a Goa minister announced plans to shift stray dogs from public places to shelters. Meanwhile, the High Court has directed the Centre to submit the 2025 street dog census data by September 8.

headline: Goa Bans Fresh Contractual Appointments
summary: The Goa government has banned fresh contractual appointments and introduced a one-time regularisation policy for staff who complete 10 years of service. This aims to overhaul employment practices across state departments.

headline: Goan Pilgrims Safe After Nepal-Tibet Flash Floods
summary: A group of Goan pilgrims successfully completed their Kailash yatra despite surviving a sudden flash flood in the Nepal-Tibet region. All members returned safely.

headline: KMRL Prepares Detailed Project Report for Goa Water Metro
summary: The Kochi Metro Rail Limited (KMRL) has prepared a Detailed Project Report for a Goa Water Metro encompassing nine routes and 111 kilometers of waterways. A feasibility study for the project has been successfully completed.

headline: Travelers Share Realities of Remote Working and Living in Goa
summary: Recent reports highlight the lifestyle and monthly expenses of individuals moving from cities like Delhi and Manali to work remotely from Goa. Meanwhile, tourism authorities are cracking down on improper behavior on beaches and tightening registration rules for private shacks.

headline: Teenager Killed in Sonsodo Road Accident
summary: A 17-year-old boy named Abel Menezes tragically lost his life in a road accident in Sonsodo. Local authorities are investigating the incident.

headline: Goa Assembly Clears Housing Board Joint Ventures Bill
summary: The Goa Assembly has passed a bill enabling the Housing Board to enter into joint ventures. The legislative session also addressed various local infrastructure deadlines and project disputes.

headline: IndiGo Flight Makes Emergency Landing in Goa Due to Engine Snag
summary: A Delhi-bound IndiGo flight from Goa made a safe emergency landing following a mid-air engine failure. Passengers were safely accommodated while technical teams inspected the aircraft.

headline: E20 Petrol Available Across Goa With No Violations Found
summary: E20 petrol has been made available across Goa following extensive inspections by Oil Marketing Companies. The government confirmed that 1,209 checks found zero violations.

headline: Goa Initiates Digital Crop Survey and Expands Water Supply
summary: The Goa government has launched a digital survey to accurately map crops grown across the state. Additionally, authorities announced plans to double treated water supply to over 1,000 MLD.
